descriptions.zh:
## 使用说明
本接口的单用户QPS限制为100次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。更多信息，请参见[QPS限制](~~343507~~)。
descriptions.en:
## Usage notes

The QPS limit for this API is 100 queries per second per user. If the limit is exceeded, API calls will be throttled, which may affect your business. You can make API calls at a reasonable rate. For more information, see [QPS limits](~~343507~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live get-message-group --group-id AE35-0000-T95F --app-id VKL3000 --region cn-hangzhou
